annotations.title: Check whether a domain is live

description: For a domain your site uses: does DNS point at our server, is the HTTPS certificate in place, and does the page answer? live:true means a visitor can open https://<domain> now. A fresh domain usually takes 5-15 minutes; poll every 20-30 seconds.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. "heapy.net". Poll every 20-30 seconds after publish_site until live is true.

name: publish_status
title: Check whether a domain is live
